method: Taken from the authors' triaarbq_table.txt on the standard equilateral triangle with vertices (-1,-1/sqrt(3)), (1,-1/sqrt(3)), (0,2/sqrt(3)); mapped affinely to the Atlas reference triangle (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), with weights scaled from area sqrt(3) to area 1/2.
author: Xiao–Gimbutas
source: H. Xiao, Z. Gimbutas: A numerical algorithm for the construction of efficient quadrature rules in two and higher dimensions. Comput. Math. Appl. 59 (2010), 663–676. Original data table: https://github.com/zgimbutas/triasymq/blob/master/triaarbq_table.txt.
